# Incremental patch manifest
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# One path per line, RELATIVE TO THE PACK ROOT (i.e. the folder that has
# game\, login\, libs\, launcher\, ...). These are the files that changed in
# THIS release and should ship in L2J-Offline-Patch.zip so an existing tester
# can unzip it over their install to update without touching their database.
#
# Rules:
#   - libs\GameServer.jar is ALWAYS included automatically - do NOT list it.
#   - Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
#   - Forward or back slashes are both fine.
#   - Do NOT list files a tester may have customized (e.g. game\config\*.ini,
#     especially Rates.ini) - overwriting those would reset their settings.
#     Mention any new config keys in the release notes instead.
#   - ACCUMULATE this list across releases: keep the prior entries AND add the
#     datapack/config/html files that changed this time. The patch is a whole-file
#     overlay of CURRENT content, so a single latest patch then brings any tester
#     fully up to date - even one who skipped an earlier patch. Only remove an
#     entry if that file was deleted/renamed (or became a customizable config that
#     must not be overwritten). Java fixes need NO entry - they ride in the jar,
#     which is always included and always cumulative.
#   - The build FAILS if a listed file is missing from the pack, so a typo or a
#     stale path can't ship a broken patch.
#
# ---- current release -------------------------------------------------------
game/data/html/admin/rates.htm
game/data/scripts/handlers/chat/commands/admin/AdminRates.java
game/data/scripts/handlers/chat/commands/admin/AdminReload.java
brain/fpc_brain.py
brain/requirements.txt
brain/setup_brain.bat
brain/setup_brain.sh
scripts/Check-Updates.bat
scripts/Configure-Brain.bat
launcher/update.ps1
tools/l2admin/index.html
tools/l2admin/native-bridge.js
# v0.1.22 exception to the "no customizable configs" rule: this release adds many new
# FakePlayers.ini keys (chatter cadence, bot-to-bot chat, Phantom PvP) and turns Phantom
# PvP on, so the file ships in the patch and overwrites the tester's copy. Remove this
# entry again after v0.1.22 so later patches keep tester customizations.
game/config/Custom/FakePlayers.ini
game/data/PhantomPlaystyles.xml
game/data/xsd/PhantomPlaystyles.xsd
game/data/PhantomPopulations.xml

game/data/scripts/handlers/skill/targets/Party.java
game/data/skill icons
images
# Module framework: reference Hello World module. config/module.ini is intentionally
# omitted so a tester who enabled it is not reset, and game/config/Modules.ini is a
# protected config shipped only in the full pack; the framework defaults to enabled
# with no Modules.ini present, so a patch-only tester still works.
game/modules/hello-world/module.json
game/modules/hello-world/MODULE.md
game/modules/hello-world/TESTING.md
game/modules/hello-world/scripts/HelloWorldModule.java
# Module framework: reference Custom Item module (resource-root proof). config/module.ini
# is omitted for the same reason as above; its item definition ships as a normal module file.
game/modules/custom-item/module.json
game/modules/custom-item/MODULE.md
game/modules/custom-item/TESTING.md
game/modules/custom-item/scripts/CustomItemModule.java
game/modules/custom-item/data/items/60000-60009.xml
Start-Server.bat
Stop-Server.bat
launcher/launcher.ps1
launcher/stop.ps1
# launcher/assets/* is intentionally NOT patched: the running LivingWorld.exe holds
# these open (e.g. launcher.ico as its window icon), so overwriting them mid-update
# fails with a file-in-use error and aborts the whole patch. Ship changed launcher
# assets in the full pack instead.
